# PDF paper reader — a DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin

Read English computer-science papers inside the Harness Web UI: rendered PDF
pages with selectable t

ext, one-click AI translation/explanation, structured
reading notes that are grounded in the paper,

and agent tools that let the chat
model read, search and summarise papers for you.

The reader is a real page in the app (not an iframe), so it follows your theme,
locale and layout, a
nd every AI call uses the model configured in your profile.

| Bundle package | `@local/pdf-paper-reader` (installed from a directory) |
| Host + Client | plain

ESM / plain browser JS, no build step |
| PDF engine | PDF.js 3.11.174, vendored (Apache-2.0) |
| Te
sted against | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.2.2-rc.1, Node 20+ |
## Features

- **Paper library** — scans the session workspace for PDFs, fills in titles and
abstracts in the bac

kground, shows reading progress. Drag a PDF onto the page
or use **Upload PDF** to add one.
- **PDF

viewer** — rendered pages with a selectable text layer, zoom/fit, lazy
page rendering, remembered re

ading position, arrow-key navigation.
- **Contents rail** — the paper's own outline (PDF bookmarks m

erged with
heading detection, two-column aware, table-of-contents pages skipped).
- **In-paper searc

h** — page-numbered snippets; click to jump.
- **Selection actions** — select a passage, then *Trans

late*, *Explain*,
*Terms* or *Quote* (adds a cited blockquote to your notes). Output streams
into th

e side pane in Chinese or English.
- **Reading notes** — one click writes structured Markdown notes

(problem,
method, contributions, experiments, limitations, glossary), then edit,
preview, copy or sa

ve them to `paper-notes/` in the workspace. Existing notes
load automatically; the agent can append

prompts forbid inventing numbers and ask the model to say when something
is not in the excerpt.
- **

Agent tools** — `paper_list`, `paper_read`, `paper_search`,
`paper_save_note` are available to the c

hat agent in every session after
installation.
## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness Web UI profile with the `plugin_manager` plugin enabled
(it is part of the stan

dard `dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` bundles).
- A default model configured in **Settings → Models** (the

reader uses
`ctx.llm` + the profile's default model selection).
- Node.js 20+ (only needed to run t

he plugin's own dev checks; the plugin
itself runs inside the Host process).
## Install

`dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh

.client` declarations, and the plugin installs

### 2. Install the bundle into your profile

In the Harness Web UI, ask the agent to install the bundle from the cloned
directory (this calls the
`plugin_manager` tool):
> Install the plugin bundle at `/absolute/path/to/dsh-pdf-paper-reader`.

Or use `plugin_manager` yourself with
`action: install_bundle`, `target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-pdf-
vives restarts and can be toggled from **Settings → Plugins**.

Refresh the Web UI once. A **PDF papers** icon appears in the sidebar panel
list; clicking it opens
the reader in the central panel.
### Uninstall

Remove the `@local/pdf-paper-reader` bundle from **Settings → Plugins**, or use
`plugin_manager` wit

h `action: remove_bundle`. Reading notes stay in your
workspace under `paper-notes/`.
## Usage

1. Open the **PDF papers** panel.
2. Add papers by dropping PDFs on the library or with **Upload PDF

**; files are
copied to `<workspace>/papers/`. Any PDF already under the workspace root is
listed au

tomatically.
3. Open a paper. Use the outline or the search box to navigate.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

- Parsing, search, notes and uploads stay on the machine; nothing is uploaded
by the plugin itself.

- AI actions send only the selected passage / a size-capped paper excerpt to
the model configured in

your profile, through the Harness `llm` service.
- Prompts treat paper text as untrusted data and i

nstruct the model to ignore
instructions found inside documents.
## Architecture
| Part | Files | Responsibility |
| Host | `index.js` | Authenticated `/api/pdf.reader.*` routes (library, vendor PDF.js, file, open,

upload, explain, summarize, ask, page brief, notes) and the four agent tools. |
| Host | `lib/store.

js` | Workspace scanning, path containment, parse cache, search, notes persistence. |
| Host | `lib/

pdf.js` | PDF.js ingestion: text, outline, title/authors/abstract, section model. |
| Host | `lib/te
xt.js` | Text reconstruction: lines, document-wide column gutter detection, running-header removal,

paragraphs, heading classification. |
| Host | `lib/prompts.js` | Section-aware digest and all model

prompts. |
| Host | `lib/llm.js` | Default-model resolution, streaming, truncation reporting. |
| C
lient | `client.js` | Sidebar entry, main-panel page, PDF viewer + text layer, selection toolbar, no

tes/explain/ask panes, Markdown renderer. |
| Bundle | `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` | `dsh.bun

dle.patch` row and the `dsh.client` web module. |
| Vendored | `vendor/` | PDF.js browser + legacy b
uilds and their Apache-2.0 license. |
The bundle registers:

- `main` slot key `pdf-paper-reader` — the reader page;
- `sidebar.panellist` id `pdf-paper-reader`

— the sidebar icon;
- four Host tools listed above.
## Limitations

- **Scanned PDFs** have no extractable text; the plugin reports this instead of
generating empty not

es. Viewing still works.
- Text reconstruction is heuristic. Multi-column papers, figures, tables an

d
equations are handled reasonably (verified on ICLR, CVPR, ACL/NAACL and
NeurIPS-style PDFs), but f

igure labels can occasionally leak into adjacent
paragraphs or the outline.
- The reader is verified

with jsdom integration tests and live slot/tool
inspection; this repository intentionally contains

no screenshots or mock
previews.
